name: Gwawl

attributes.attribute: A minor character in the Welsh Mabinogion.
He sought the hand of Rhiannon against Pwyll.
Through trickery he made Pwyll yield in his courtship.
Pwyll tricked him into crawling into a bag used like a football.

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Gwawl was a minor character in the Welsh Mabinogion. He was a suitor for the hand of the goddess and queen Rhiannon, competing against the heroic king Pwyll. Through trickery Gwawl made Pwyll yield in his courtship. Pwyll then tricked Gwawl into crawling into a bag and used it like a football with his warriors.

okr.objective: Summarize the role of Gwawl as a rival suitor to Rhiannon in the Mabinogion.
key_results: Gwawl is a minor Mabinogion character
He competed with Pwyll for Rhiannon's hand
He forced Pwyll to step back through trickery
Pwyll trapped him in a bag used like a football
